name: Emergency: Call 911
summary: For any emergency anywhere in Cullman County, dial 911. Cullman County E911 sends police, fire or an ambulance.

name: Cullman County Sheriff's Office
summary: The Sheriff handles law enforcement outside city limits and in towns without their own police, and runs the county jail and pistol permits.

name: Secret Witness Tip Line
summary: Report a crime without giving your name. The Sheriff's Office runs this tip line.

name: Cullman Police Department
summary: Cullman city police. Use this number for business calls that are not emergencies.

name: Cullman Central Dispatch
summary: The city dispatch line for police patrol and lake patrol calls that are not emergencies.

name: Cullman Fire and Rescue
summary: The city fire department. Call this number for non emergency questions such as inspections.

name: Cullman County Emergency Management Agency
summary: The EMA helps the county get ready for storms and disasters and keeps the county storm shelter list.

name: Cullman County Animal Control
summary: Call about stray, lost or dangerous animals in the county.

name: Cullman City Hall
summary: City Hall is home to the City Clerk, the Mayor and the City Council. Call the main line and they will point you in the right direction.

name: Mayor's Office
summary: The Mayor leads city government and works with the City Council.

name: Cullman City Council
summary: The council has five members, each over an area like public safety, tourism, public works, utilities and general government. Agendas are posted on the city website.

name: City Revenue Office (Business Licenses)
summary: Get or renew a City of Cullman business license here.

name: Cullman Building Inspections
summary: Permits and inspections for building inside the city.

name: Cullman Municipal Court
summary: Handles city tickets and misdemeanor cases.

summary: Runs city parks, ball leagues, the Wellness and Aquatic Center, the OmniPlex and big events like Oktoberfest and the Strawberry Festival.

summary: The county commission oversees county roads, budget and services. The office is open weekdays from 7:30 a.m. to 4:30 p.m.
hours: Mon to Fri 7:30 AM to 4:30 PM

summary: The main courthouse line can connect you to most county offices.
